priorityList: Use Tiger's Fury on cooldown, ideally when energy is low.
Use Berserk or Incarnation on cooldown, preferably when Tiger's Fury is active.
Cast Chomp whenever the Chomp Enabler buff is active.
Use Prowl or Shadowmeld in combat to apply an empowered Rake if the current Rake is refreshable or lacks a stealth bonus.
Cast Ferocious Bite for free whenever Apex Predator's Craving procs.
Use Feral Frenzy or Frantic Frenzy if you have 2 or fewer Combo Points (up to 4 during Berserk).
Cast Convoke the Spirits while Tiger's Fury is active and you have 2 or fewer Combo Points.
Use Rip as a finisher (4+ Combo Points) if the bleed is refreshable or Tiger's Fury is active.
Use Ferocious Bite as a finisher at 4 or more Combo Points (5 during Berserk) to spend excess Combo Points.
Maintain Rake on the target, refreshing it if it has less than 4.5 seconds remaining or to benefit from Tiger's Fury snapshots.
Maintain Moonfire (if talented) on the target, refreshing it if it has less than 4.2 seconds remaining.
Use Shred as your primary builder to generate Combo Points when dots are maintained.
Use Regrowth when Predatory Swiftness is active to prevent the buff from wasting.
Use offensive trinkets and combat potions during Berserk or Incarnation windows for maximum effect.
